_comment: INFRA-MAP-COPY-1 (2026-09-21 humanize pass). Authored display-copy overrides for the map pages (infrastructure.html, hub-for-hubs.html), both rendered from the derived registry data/infra-registry.json. The registry scrapes each source page's <title> and meta description verbatim, and a number of source pages publish those broken: descriptions cut off mid-sentence by an earlier automated sweep ('How Autonity', 'A weekly cron gathers a window'), or empty outright. An entry here replaces the DISPLAY copy on the map pages only; the source page and the registry row are untouched. Keys are validated against the registry by scripts/lib/infra-map.mjs (validateOverrides): a key whose page has left the registry fails the render, so this table can never mask a deleted page. Hub-family rows (guides/*-hub.html, chaingraph/guide-*.html) get their '(N tools / N ChainGraph nodes)' phrase recomputed at render; never type a count here. Copy rules: complete sentences, no em-dashes, no comma splices, no fragments (CONTRACT §1.4 + copy-hallmarks gate).

chaingraph/exporters/qr-preview.html.description: Preview the QR code an OCG verify deep-link will carry: version, module grid, and the exact URL a phone camera decodes.

chaingraph/openchain-graph-spec.html.title: OpenChainGraph Standard: Technical Specification
chaingraph/openchain-graph-spec.html.description: The normative OpenChainGraph specification: artifact envelope and execution hash, RFC 8785 canonicalization, the financial payload layer, and the §15 conformance gate suite an implementation must pass.

chaingraph/guide-prov-dm.html.description: How OpenChainGraph artifacts map onto W3C PROV-DM: the JSON-LD context that aliases OCG fields to prov terms, and how to feed artifacts into triple stores and ProvToolbox pipelines you already run.

chaingraph/checklist-run-verifier.html.description: Paste a run bundle from the Checklist Run Executor. Every step receipt hash is recomputed, the hash chain is walked, and the Merkle root is rebuilt; a single altered field in any step is named exactly.

chaingraph/ocg-chain-builder.html.title: OpenChainGraph Chain Builder: How Workflows Chain
chaingraph/ocg-chain-builder.html.description: A click-to-compose walkthrough for newcomers: assemble a multi-step compliance workflow and watch parent_hash provenance wire up, then compare it with the paper trail it replaces. It teaches the concept; it does not execute. To run a chain for real, use the Workbench or Canvas.

chaingraph/explainers/at-e05-acu-basket..description: How the Auton Currency Unit pegged to a seven-currency basket with IMF SDR methodology: fixed quantities, floating daily weights, and what the mechanic contributed to USDZ design. Educational record, not financial advice.

chaingraph/explainers/at-e04-forecastath.description: How Autonity's four Forecastathon seasons were scored: the Season 1 to 3 composite covering performance, liquidity provision, accuracy, and community growth, then the Season 4 switch to raw PnL. Educational record.

chaingraph/explainers/at-e01-prediction-.description: How scalar and binary event contracts pay out, why the payoff shape changes everything, and how Autonity ran forecast futures in Forecastathon Season 1. Educational record, not financial advice.

chaingraph/public-money-evidence-explain.description: When the full record of a public payment lives inside an operator's system, what can an outsider actually verify? How receipts and anchors let an auditor confirm a payment discharged exactly once, across rails.

chaingraph/mandate-loop-explainer.html.description: The mandate loop, end to end: a person signs a Work Mandate, a compiler turns its clauses into literal gates on the workflow, routine cases run straight through, and exceptions route back to a human.

chaingraph/evidence-estate-explainer.htm.description: The evidence estate, end to end: how an artifact is reduced to one SHA-256 digest, how four independent rails pin that digest to third-party time, and how a stranger verifies the result alone.

chaingraph/settlement-asset-lifecycle-ex.description: Eight stages carry a settlement asset from issuance to attested reconciliation. The operational spine travels between arrangements; the asset model underneath does not, and two of the five models have no backing set to check at all.

chaingraph/why-openchain-graph.html.description: Is OpenChainGraph actually new? The real prior art (in-toto, SLSA, OpenLineage, AP2, verifiable AI), what OCG borrows from each, what is genuinely fused for the first time, and the timeline that made it possible.

chaingraph/aiact-article12-record-keepin.description: A field-by-field mapping from OpenChainGraph v0.4 execution receipt members to the EU AI Act Article 12 automatic-logging obligations, with the Regulation's text quoted rather than summarized.

docs/receipt-verification.html.description: Verify a compute-integrity receipt on-chain with one read-only eth_call against the RISC Zero Groth16 verifier: which fields matter, and what each check proves about the journal output.

trust/lna-policy.html.description: What Chromium's Local Network Access blocks, the attack class it closes, and why the ainumbers.co app needs explicit permission to reach a helmd engine on 127.0.0.1.

guides/agentic-rail-scenario.html.description: Three agent payment scenarios, each mapped to a four-tool chain: A2A bank transfers, card mandates, and x402 flows differ in protocol stack, consent model, and MCP integration.

guides/ai-act-evidence-cron.html.description: A weekly cron maps the window's execution and decision receipts into an OSCAL assessment-results document and an ISO/IEC 24970 log export, then anchors the bundle for the Aug 2 enforcement window.

guides/reserve-watch-continuous-verifica.description: A weekly cron replays a stablecoin issuer's disclosed reserve report through the GENIUS Act checker and emits a signed, anchored, replayable receipt, with no human re-running the check by hand.

guides/ledger-consensus-finality-hub.htm.description: Where XRPL- and Stellar-style terminal-branch and bidirectional finality fit alongside rollup challenge windows, validity proofs, and instant BFT, for teams documenting a counterparty's finality claim.

guides/ebl-control-evidence-guide.html.description: How to show a court, a bank, or a counterparty that an electronic bill of lading has one holder at a time: control-transfer events checked against MLETR singularity and continuous-control requirements.

guides/basel-take2-impact-assessment-gui.description: Reproduce the 2026 US Basel Endgame reproposal's capital relief on your own book: risk weights across residential, retail, corporate and SME, and off-balance-sheet exposures, beyond the headline number.

guides/sr262-model-risk-monitoring-hub.h.description: Why AINumbers kernels are not SR 26-2 models: the guidance defines models as method-based and explicitly excludes deterministic, rule-based calculations, and the hub maps each kernel category to that reading.

guides/benchmark-series-reserve-scorecar.description: Issue #1 of the Stablecoin Reserve Scorecard: Circle's EURC reserve reports of June 2 and June 30, 2026, recomputed against declared MiCA Article 30, 36, and 54 reserve terms and attestation evidence.

guides/recomputation-evidence-pack-guide.description: How already-verified OCG receipts become a recomputation evidence pack a CPA firm can consume as specialist input under AU-C 500 and 620: digests only, nothing re-derived, nothing new to trust.

guides/bilateral-head-commit-cosign-guid.description: Two organizations, two Helms, one cosigned head-commit: portable, offline-checkable evidence that a named counterparty saw and signed a specific head, with no shared service in the middle.

guides/broker-dealer-ops-hub.html.description: How the 15c3-3 Exhibit A customer reserve calculator and the TRACE/CAT reporting lint fit together for broker-dealer operations, alongside the Reg BI and Form CRS obligations.

guides/fr2052a-liquidity-report-referenc.description: A reference to the FR 2052a Complex Institution Liquidity Monitoring Report: the appendix inventory, the report structure, and what stays confidential, indexed to the Fed's own reporting bundle.

guides/formal-verification-evidence.html.description: Five kernels carry formal-verification evidence today: what exhaustive enumeration, property-based testing, and one machine-checked Dafny proof each establish, and why the claim is kept narrow on purpose.

chaingraph/guide-buildtype.html.description: Where OpenChainGraph's buildType URI fits a SLSA pipeline: the field names the exact algorithm that constructed an execution_hash, the way SLSA's buildType names a build. Sigstore and Cosign compose unchanged.

chaingraph/guide-kya-os-checkpoint-inter.description: A side-by-side read for integrators: where KYA-OS/Checkpoint response-proofs and OpenChainGraph's shipped primitives overlap, and what each does that the other does not. Informative, non-conformant.

guides/webmcp-demo-2.html.description: A click-by-click procedure for checking whether a ChainGraph page has registered its tool with the browser's agent surface, then running the human-facing call. Three steps, needed once per computer.
